name: grupo-nobre-crm
description: Orquestração local do CRM Grupo Nobre.

scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:generate -w grupo-nobre-crm-server && npm run db:deploy -w grupo-nobre-crm-server
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,ui -c yellow,cyan "npm run start:dev -w grupo-nobre-crm-server" "npm run dev -w ui"
scripts.dev:all: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run dev
scripts.demo: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed && npm run dev
